summary: Collection renames announced in Ansible 9: community.sap to community.sap_libs (old removed in Ansible 10), ibm.spectrum_virtualize to ibm.storage_virtualize (redirects in 10, removed in 12), and t_systems_mms.icinga_director to telekom_mms.icinga_director (redirects in 9, removed in 11).
questions: What should I rename ibm.spectrum_virtualize to?
t_systems_mms.icinga_director shows deprecation warnings, what's the new FQCN?
When is community.sap removed from Ansible?

answer_card.title: Renamed collections: update your FQCNs
answer_card.answer_md:
| Old | New | Removed from |
|---|---|---|
| `community.sap` | `community.sap_libs` | Ansible 10 |
| `ibm.spectrum_virtualize` | `ibm.storage_virtualize` | Ansible 12 (redirects from 10.0.0) |
| `t_systems_mms.icinga_director` | `telekom_mms.icinga_director` | Ansible 11 (redirects from 9.0.0) |
